labels.label: risk
labels.reason: States that a dump/restore, pg_upgrade, or logical replication is required to migrate data from any previous release, which is mandatory migration work.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Changes PL/pgSQL bound cursor variable assignment so the string value no longer matches the variable name, which can break code that relies on it.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Disallows NULLS NOT DISTINCT indexes for primary keys, so existing DDL or schema definitions using this will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: REINDEX DATABASE and reindexdb no longer process system catalog indexes, so maintenance scripts relying on that must switch to REINDEX SYSTEM or reindexdb --system.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Tightens GENERATED column restrictions on inherited and partitioned tables, requiring matching generation status across parent and child, which can break existing schemas or DDL.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removes the pg_walinspect functions pg_get_wal_records_info_till_end_of_wal() and pg_get_wal_stats_till_end_of_wal(), breaking any callers.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Renames the server variable force_parallel_mode to debug_parallel_query, so configs using the old name need updating.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removes the ability to manually create views with ON SELECT rules, which breaks any scripts or schemas that do this.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removes the server variable vacuum_defer_cleanup_age, so configurations setting it will need to change, e.g. use hot_standby_feedback or replication slots.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removes promote_trigger_file, so standby promotion workflows using it must move to pg_ctl promote or pg_promote().

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removes the read-only server variables lc_collate and lc_ctype, so queries or tooling like SHOW lc_collate that reference them will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Changes role inheritance semantics for member roles added with GRANT, which can alter effective privileges for existing setups.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Restricts CREATEROLE privileges so role management that previously worked now requires ADMIN OPTION, which may break administrative workflows.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removes the postmaster binary symbolic links, so scripts or service definitions that invoke postmaster will fail.
